# Collision

> Collision is the AI you hire to run growth. It is a single growth intelligence that researches, writes, distributes, and learns across every surface a business depends on — replacing the tools, freelancers, and headcount that would otherwise make up an entire growth stack.

Collision is built for founders and growth teams who want one conversation, one memory, and one source of truth instead of a scattered stack of point tools (SEO tool, writing tool, analytics dashboard, marketing automation platform). You talk to Collision in plain English about the outcome you want, and it plans, executes, and learns across every channel — approval-based, so nothing publishes without you.

## What Collision owns

- **Reach** — LinkedIn, X, SEO, and AI search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini): building demand where people already look, including inside AI answer engines.
- **Content** — Blogs, newsletters, landing pages, website copy, product launches: turning a point of view into a system people remember.
- **Revenue** — Gmail, email campaigns, outbound, storefront and store growth, community distribution: turning attention into conversations.
- **Intelligence** — Competitor research, positioning, messaging, analytics, growth strategy, growth experiments: learning what works and making the next decision better.

## How it works

1. State an objective in plain English (e.g. "grow our LinkedIn," "why are signups down?").
2. Collision researches, plans, writes, and distributes across the right channels, coordinated behind the scenes by specialized systems (research, planning, writing, optimization, analysis, execution).
3. You approve the work; Collision learns from outcomes and improves the next cycle.
